services.value: Provides ORELAP/EPA/TNI accredited water testing services in Salem, Oregon, including residential & well water bacterial testing (e.g., Total Coliform/E.coli), public water supply EPA compliance testing, irrigation water testing (e.g., Free Coliform Count Test), and industrial wastewater & stormwater testing including a range of parameters (e.g., BOD, COD, metals, pH, TSS, Oil & Grease, and others).
